answer: Think of trust as rain running off a basalt ridge: it starts at a few verified seed agents and flows only along real payment and attestation edges, SybilRank-style. A sybil farm can mint thousands of identities, yet they touch honest agents through just a handful of attack edges, so short random walks from the seeds rarely reach them. Rewards scale with the trust that lands, so fakes earn copper scraps while honest agents earn the bulk.
